about: Forty query samples for the smoke run, and nothing else: this is a fixture that proves the
training loop works end to end before any real data exists, not training data. The real
files come from ticket 62's training/data/assemble.py and have thousands of rows over six
Each row names a datapoint in the train half of bench/sql-benchmark.json and carries the one
thing the benchmark does not: the reasoning line the sub-agent has to write before its SQL.
The statement itself is the datapoint's own reference statement, which build_gold.py has
already run through the guard against the synthetic year, so a target here is a statement
that really answers its question. Only generated datapoints are used, because those are
written in euros the way this prompt's rules ask for them, and none of the nine ids the
query prompt's own worked examples are drawn from is in the list.
smoke_samples.py turns this into the JSONL train.py reads, building each prompt with the
product's own query_prompt so a fixture cannot drift from the app.
